goal.bug_report: When a user presses Ctrl-C during click.prompt(), an unhandled exception can intermittently escape while Click is already handling the abort. It was observed on an Ubuntu ARM CI runner and appears timing-sensitive. Normal x64/macOS/Windows runs often succeed. Find the causal race in the pre-fix source, not a platform-specific workaround.

Do not use http_get or external bug search. Derive the causal boundary from the supplied pre-fix source.
Do not special-case ARM, isatty, prompt(), or only the Aborted! print unless the code evidence proves that is the general causal boundary.
Preserve standalone_mode=False semantics rather than swallowing interrupts globally.
The fix must be general across abort reporting, ClickException reporting, and the final standalone exit path if the same race can occur there.
Return a minimal unified diff whose paths are exactly click_under_test/src/click/core.py. Modify production code only.
